#### RequiresReauthentication

```text
public static System.Boolean RequiresReauthentication(System.Exception exception)
```

Checks if an exception indicates a token/credential failure that requires re-authentication.

- Parameter `exception`: The exception to check.

Returns: True if this is a token failure requiring re-authentication.

Remarks: Token failures require invalidating the cached authentication and re-authenticating. Permission failures (user lacks privilege, user disabled) don&#x27;t require re-authentication because the authentication is valid - the user just doesn&#x27;t have access.
